ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; high-intensity pixels are concentrated in distal lobe tips, while low-intensity pixels occupy the central and proximal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs located on the distal ends of both lobes, with the left lobe exhibiting a larger area of white pigmentation than the right. Mottled gray-scale transition clusters are visible along the mid-to-upper trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge characterized by irregular, sharp-peaked protrusions and variable depth valleys; most prominent on the outer thirds of each lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature on the lower margins sweeping into a sharp upward vertical curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, textured, high-contrast white/grey pixel formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips and along segments of the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation on the distal lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; distinct irregular notch/defect on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy three-dimensional calcified textures on the outer periphery of the tips that disrupt the smooth geometric line of the leading edge.
